specialized_polynomial: f_t(x)=prim_x P(t,x), obtained by dividing P(t,x) by the positive gcd of its coefficients
congruence_certificate: P(2+319*n,x)=P(2,x) in F_p[n,x] for p=11 and p=29

modular_consequences.mod_11: squarefree irreducible-factor degrees (2,7,14), hence an element of order 14
modular_consequences.content: the leading coefficient is nonzero at both primes, so the content is a unit modulo both primes

group_theoretic_conclusion: Every specialization group embeds in M23 and contains elements of orders 23 and 14; the ATLAS maximal-subgroup list forces equality with M23.
theorem: For every integer t congruent to 2 modulo 319, Gal(prim_x P(t,x)/Q)=M23 in its natural degree-23 action.
